identity.name: Tempered Blade
identity.description: Each affordable normal melee activation costs 1 stamina; damage targets the current enemy. Piercing bypasses that amount of enemy block. Ordinary attacks activate once per round; explicit extra-activation effects may repeat them.
identity.lore: The roadside smith folds patience into every bar.

effects.description: Deal physical damage to the current enemy.
effects.condition: Item is packed and all activation costs are affordable.

conditions: Both unlocked ingredients are packed and form an orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Consume nothing if requirements fail. If the result cannot fit after consumption, it remains unpacked.
recipes.description: Combine two Field Blade into one Tempered Blade.

visual.brief: A clean leaf-point steel sword with a bronze guard that turns upward and a tight brown leather grip. A fuller separates the broad blade planes.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
definingFeatures: A clean leaf-point steel sword with a bronze guard that turns upward and a tight brown leather grip
A fuller separates the broad blade planes.
